causal_interpretation.aggregate_only_intervention_meaning: Replacing mt['confidence'] repairs profile confidence 48/48, proving direct profile-confidence lineage from native MT aggregate output.
causal_interpretation.score_independence_from_confidence_inter: The entire overall-score signed-error distribution is identical before and after weekly+aggregate confidence repair; therefore the remaining score divergence is causally independent of these synthetic confidence corrections.
causal_interpretation.state_independence_from_confidence_inter: State-hash parity remains 0/48 after weekly+aggregate confidence repair; additional upstream state/feature divergences are mandatory.
causal_interpretation.weekly_only_intervention_meaning: The M77.19.6.5.2.5 WEEKLY_ONLY mutation occurred after native mt.analyze() had already calculated aggregate confidence, so unchanged profile confidence does not prove weekly confidence is irrelevant to the native formula. It proves there is no downstream recomputation from the mutated weekly state.
